reasoning: As of March 6, 2026, we're 25 days into the resolution window (Dec 4, 2025 - Mar 31, 2026) with 56 days remaining. The question asks if Russia will conduct drone, missile, or air strikes on NATO territory or NATO embassies/consulates. Key considerations: (1) Russia has conducted occasional strikes on NATO airspace/territory before (e.g., Polish territory incidents), though direct intentional strikes are rare; (2) The ongoing Ukraine conflict creates elevated tensions; (3) NATO members bordering Russia/Ukraine (Poland, Romania, Baltics) face higher risk; (4) Russia typically avoids direct NATO escalation due to deterrence; (5) The 4-month window provides substantial time for an incident. Historical precedent suggests occasional border incidents occur, but deliberate strikes remain uncommon. The probability reflects the elevated but still relatively low baseline risk of direct Russian military action against NATO territory.
